notes.english_account: The page continues a discussion of recovering homotopy information from a fundamental group, twisted coefficient categories, cohomology functors and cup-product structure. It then describes a derived-category candidate involving complexes and locally constant cohomology, with triangulated and multiplicative structure and possibly derived Hom. The writer expressly does not know whether those data recover the homotopy type, and expresses considerably more confidence in continuing to a nonabelian construction using an (n+1)-category of locally constant n-champs for every n. This reports the page, not a proof.

notes.page_date_title_evidence: The author number 38 is visible at the top centre. The archive 183 is at the lower left in a distinct archive hand and is represented only by a comment. No date, title, salutation, closing or signature occurs on this page. The prose begins and ends as a continuation.
notes.math_triggered_reading_decisions: The meanings of the coefficient data and derived operations prompted attention to pi indices, the H degree and separator, the doubled L above the tensor, the doubled R beside Hom, and n+1 versus n. These were decided from ink or left uncertain; category agreement, expected syntax, and mathematical expectation were not used to repair the wording. The tensor point is explicitly nonsemantic. The formula separator is left open because its paired marks could be punctuation or a comma plus detached point.
notes.proof_scope: No proof, independent re-proof, computation or mathematical verification was attempted. Reading the assertions and tracing the notation are not recorded as proof checks. check_events is therefore empty.
notes.isolated_mark_policy: Physical presence and approximate position are recorded separately from authorship and semantic role. The coloured compact spots are preserved with origin unassigned; colour alone is not used to establish authorship. Pale diffuse copy grain, including the faint long streak above triangulé and a pale speck beneath the cropped multiplicative context, is not promoted to manuscript ink.
notes.paragraph_decision: One continuous prose block is used because Une fois has no added line spacing or inward indent. It is a sentence start, not by itself evidence of a paragraph.
notes.underline_decision: The two underline segments under non abélien are on one level, not a double underline. Their interruption is retained. The second begins within the terminal horizontal extent of l; a short overlay preserves that small portion. Intended emphasis is not inferred beyond the observed strokes.

workflow_feedback: The once-only few-thousand-pixel crop procedure was followed; enlarging tiny points adds no new source detail, so uncertainties of origin remain explicit.
A standard field for physical presence versus mark function/ownership would make isolated-mark reporting more uniform.
A canonical convention for an underline gap that cuts through part of a letter would reduce representational differences; this reading records endpoints and uses a short inline overlay.
The distinction between adding alternatives to an unchanged uncertain H reading and a substantive H difference is useful; it was applied to donnant.
